product_family: EndNote is an enterprise reference and citation management tool for researchers, with desktop (Windows/Mac), web, and iOS clients. Includes EndNote Click browser plugin, AI-powered Research Assistant (2025+) for document summarization and analysis, and cloud-based library sharing with institutional support.

certifications.name: ISO 27001 (Information Security Management System)
certifications.proof_quote: Clarivate PLC holds ISO 27001 certification covering ISMS supporting IPG, LS&H, and A&G systems, products, and services. Certification based on ISO/IEC 27001:2022 edition.

certifications.name: ISO 27017 (Cloud Security Controls)
certifications.proof_quote: Clarivate maintains ISO 27017 certification for cloud information security controls.

certifications.name: ISO 27018 (Personal Data Protection in Cloud)
certifications.proof_quote: Clarivate holds ISO 27018 certification for personal data protection in the cloud.

certifications.name: ISO 27032 (Cybersecurity Incident Management)
certifications.proof_quote: Clarivate maintains ISO 27032 certification for cybersecurity incident management.

certifications.name: ISO 27701 (Privacy Information Management System)
certifications.proof_quote: Clarivate holds ISO 27701 certification for privacy information management system.

certifications.name: ISO 22301 (Business Continuity Management)
certifications.proof_quote: Clarivate maintains ISO 22301 certification for business continuity management.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Multiple Clarivate products maintain SOC 2 Type II certification, which evaluates both the design and operating effectiveness of controls over a defined period, typically six to twelve months.

certifications.name: PCI DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard)
certifications.proof_quote: Clarivate supports compliance with PCI DSS, a global security standard that protects cardholder data and secures payment card transactions. Vendors are contractually bound to meet PCI DSS standards.

certifications.name: FedRAMP (U.S. Federal Cloud Security Authorization)
certifications.proof_quote: Clarivate's cloud services maintain FedRAMP authorization for U.S. federal government compliance.

certifications.name: GDPR Compliance (via Standard Contractual Clauses)
certifications.proof_quote: Where Clarivate receives personal data protected under GDPR from outside EU/EEA, parties agree to enter into EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs), with Clarivate as data importer and Client as data exporter. Data Processing Addendum dated June 2025 provides comprehensive GDPR terms.

certifications.name: HIPAA (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of HIPAA certification or compliance claims found on endnote.com or clarivate.com trust center documentation.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Governance)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO/IEC 42001 AI governance certification found; not listed in Clarivate's published certifications.

certifications.name: CSA STAR AI (Cloud Security Alliance AI Certification)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of CSA STAR AI certification found in Clarivate or EndNote documentation.

privacy.ai_training_note: Clarivate explicitly states: 'They use commercially pre-trained large language models (LLMs) as part of their information retrieval and augmentation framework—they do not train public LLMs. They access these LLMs through a private setup, and they do not share or pass any user data to LLMs for any purpose.' EndNote 2025 Research Assistant uses this approach. Minimal copyright risk due to non-training-based processing.
privacy.data_region: Not publicly specified; multiple data centers referenced but specific regional locations not disclosed in available documentation

security.name: Access Controls
security.value: Implemented and monitored across all systems

security.name: Security Operations Center (SOC)
security.value: 24/7 SOC with SIEM correlation, threat intelligence integration, and incident response framework

security.name: Vulnerability Management
security.value: HackerOne Responsible Disclosure Program (hackerone@clarivate.com); SAST/DAST testing, multi-level reviews, third-party assessments

security.name: Secure Software Development Lifecycle
security.value: Industry-standard SSDLC with threat modeling, secure architecture, and compliance integration; security embedded from earliest design stages

security.name: Data Recovery
security.value: Data recovery and retention features protect user work; cloud storage with flexible retention policies

products.name: EndNote Desktop
products.data_scope: Local + cloud sync via EndNote Web; libraries shareable with up to 1,000 users
products.notes: Windows and Mac support; unlimited local references; 3-year cloud storage for institutional subscriptions

products.name: EndNote Web
products.data_scope: Cloud-hosted; accessible from any device; real-time collaboration
products.notes: Integrated with Word Online (Microsoft 365 certified); direct integrations with research databases

products.name: EndNote Click
products.data_scope: Browser-based reference discovery and capture; integrates with web of Science, PubMed, and other databases
products.notes: Data handling explicitly documented; does not train on user capture history

products.name: EndNote Research Assistant
products.data_scope: Document summarization, key takeaway extraction, and translation within user's own libraries; no external training data usage
products.notes: Uses commercial LLMs via private APIs; user data not shared with external LLM providers; no training on customer documents

compare.pricing_model: Subscription-based: perpetual license (pay-once), annual subscription, and institutional/site licenses available; 20% promotional discount noted in 2025/2026 campaigns
compare.data_residency: Not publicly specified; Clarivate operates multiple data centers globally but specific regional options not disclosed

flags: All certifications are held by parent company Clarivate, not directly by endnote.com. Clarivate's trust center confirms these certifications apply to their services and products (including Academic products like EndNote), but no product-specific certification documents are publicly available from endnote.com.

HIPAA: No certification claims found. EndNote is not positioned as a HIPAA-compliant healthcare tool and does not appear to market itself for healthcare/clinical data handling. Institutions using research data (not healthcare) would not require HIPAA.
No dedicated EndNote trust center exists; reliance on parent company Clarivate trust center documentation. This is standard for subsidiary products but may create clarity gap for procurement teams.
AI training posture is clearly stated and favorable (no customer data training), but this clarity is found only in blog posts and announcements, not in formal security/privacy documentation.
Data residency locations not publicly disclosed; only that multiple data centers exist globally.
